description: This file defines the authentication/lock state management for a Flutter app, including enums for lock reasons and the AuthState class which models various authentication states with relevant properties.

classes.name: AuthState
classes.description: Models the authentication state of the user, including initialization, login status, lock status, lock reason, and last error message.

methods.name: AuthState._
methods.description: Private constructor used internally to create specific authentication states.

methods.name: AuthState.uninitialized
methods.description: Factory constructor representing an uninitialized authentication state.

methods.name: AuthState.loggedOut
methods.description: Factory constructor representing a logged-out state, optionally including an error message.

methods.name: AuthState.locked
methods.description: Factory constructor representing a locked state with a specified lock reason and optional error message.

methods.name: AuthState.unlocked
methods.description: Factory constructor representing an unlocked (active) state with optional error message.

methods.name: AuthState.copyWith
methods.description: Method to create a copy of the current state with an updated lastErrorMessage.
